text:
jordan: heads up — incident-bot didn't page for sev1 alerts targeting AcmeCorp starting ~16:50 UTC. pager duty shows no incoming payloads for those incidents. anyone seeing related failures?

incident-bot: :warning: Suppressed 12 notifications due to dedupe filter error. dedupe_key parse failed (missing X-Customer-ID). log_id=abc123

ops-bot: observed spike in suppressed_count on incident-bot.service between 2024-04-09T16:50Z and 16:58Z. 502s from webhook-proxy not seen, looks like payload made it to bot but failed parsing.

sam: I'm oncall, will take. can you paste the exact error lines? could be header rotation or proxy stripping headers.

jordan: attaching log snippet:
```
ERROR dedupe_parser: invalid payload, missing customer_id header
stack: /src/dedupe/parse.go:87
context: {"msg_id":"m-9f3","raw_headers":"Host: webhook.internal
User-Agent: pd-webhook
..."}
```

maria: confirmed from PagerDuty side — no webhook receipts for those event ids. we did receive additional manual pages later. @oncall-scheduler, can ops escalate manually for impacted customers now?

lee: i'll take manual escalation for AcmeCorp. mitigation idea: disable dedupe filter as hotfix (temporary) so bot will always forward. who can deploy?

kyle: i can push a hotfix. plan: set DISABLE_DEDUPE=true and restart incident-bot workers. ETA 5m. command: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/incident-bot DISABLE_DEDUPE=true && kubectl rollout restart deploy/incident-bot`

ops-bot: deploy started by kyle. rollout status: 1/3 pods updated -> 3/3 pods ready. tailing logs now.

sam: after restart i'm seeing delivered PD requests for the previously suppressed alerts (7 delivered). monitoring shows no more parse errors. :white_check_mark:

kyle: legacy SMS fallback also enabled for 30m as backup: `PATCH /config/fallback {"sms":true}`

jordan: quick impact summary — 6 customers experienced delayed pages (median delay 6m, max 8m for AcmeCorp). customer-facing SLA blip recorded for AcmeCorp. filing postmortem P0. action owners: validate header parsing @sam, add unit tests + CI gate @maria, improve suppressed-pages alerting @lee.

oncall-scheduler: updated rotations + temporary escalation policy posted to #oncall. follow-up sync in 30 minutes to review root cause and timeline.

maria: starting the PR to harden header validation and decode fallback. will add unit + integration tests for header loss cases.

jordan: thanks everyone — keep coordinating in this thread. we'll include timeline + comms in the postmortem. :heart:
